audit.scope: Production npm graph of the exact candidate lock. Next 16.4.1 and DOMPurify 3.4.17 are pinned. GitHub withdrew the historical braces advisory GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm on 2026-10-23. KaTeX remains an inherited low severity finding.

advisories.detail: Inherited KaTeX 0.16.47 advisory remains unresolved and browser reachability is confirmed: member and guest hosts enable mermaidEnabled independently of aiEnabled=false; mermaid.ts dynamically imports mermaid-to-excalidraw and actual Next webpack browser chunks include Mermaid and KaTeX modules. Mermaid clipboard/diagram input can therefore reach the local rendering chain. The official advisory requires pre-existing Object.prototype pollution or attacker-controlled option prototypes, plus attacker-controlled math; KaTeX itself does not create the pollution. Trust defaults alone do not establish safety under that precondition, and sanitizer bypass/exploitability was not tested. No AI-service or external-network access is implied.
